formal_results: For every laminar cycle-cover instance satisfying H, the cycle-deletion reduction preserves feasibility.
proof_content: Delete one representative edge from each selected cycle and charge the repair path to the laminar parent. The charging step is valid under H.
exact_gap: Remove the laminarity hypothesis H without losing the repair-path bound.
assumptions: H: the selected cycle family is laminar
dependencies: Prove that uncrossing preserves the representative-edge ledger.
